On: your keys are stored, encrypted, in your StreamDek account — sign in on your TV or another phone and your services are already there, so you only enter each key once. Off: they stay on this device alone and StreamDek keeps no copy of them, but every other device needs its own keys entered separately. Switching off copies your keys to this device before removing them from your account, so nothing is lost either way.
